purpose: Driver step towards VideoToolbox's Metal transfer (y2s41), both files of Nord2Metal.bundle. libredwoodair.dylib = the installed y2s40 library (reproduced bit for bit) with three objects changed: the AIR translator (air_to_nir.c: any same-size bitcast between vectors, casts in constant expressions; air_intrinsics.c: air.pack.* / air.unpack.* for unorm4x8, unorm2x16 and rgb10a2, sinpi / cospi) -- the two things VTMTSComputeFunction was refused for in run q10hp -- and air_metal.c: a module the translator refuses is saved in /private/var/db/nord2-metal/refused (only if that directory exists; this transaction makes it) so that the next refusal can be worked on at the build machine. Nord2Metal = the installed y2s38 objects with redwooddrawable.m changed: an RGBA8 texture over a 'BGRA' surface (the bytes as they lie), R8/RG8 textures (unorm and uint) over ONE PLANE of a '420f'/'420v' surface in place. Previous files kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/*.pre-vt; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt-undo.sh.
